# Step - to_e

`to_e` · `toE` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves to the incident edges in the given Direction, optionally only edges with the given labels.

## Forms

```text
to_e(arg1: Direction)
to_e(arg1: any, arg2: any)
to_e(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).to_e(Direction.OUT, "knows").count().next()   // 2
```
